jobs.title: Senior Brand / Web Designer (SF/NYC In-Person)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Mintlify?

We're on a mission to empower builders.

  • Massive reach: Our docs platform serves 100 million+ developers every year and powers documentation for 20,000+ companies, including Anthropic, Microsoft, PayPal, Spotify, Coinbase, X, and over 20% of the last YC batch.

  • Small team, huge impact: We recently passed 65 employees and raised a $45 million Series B led by A16Z and Salesforce Ventures. Each new hire has a huge impact on shaping the company's trajectory.

  • Culture of slope over y-intercept: We value learning velocity, grit, and unapologetically unique personalities.

We grew in value faster than headcount and we’re looking to align the two quickly.

What you'll work on here:

  • Lead end-to-end brand design projects, from exploration to final polish

  • Collaborate with Heads of Design and Marketing on strategy

  • Create compelling visuals that resonate with developers

  • Build and maintain our brand guidelines

  • Express ideas through high-fidelity mockups in Figma, Paper, Replit, or design tools of choice

What you bring to the table:

  • 4+ years of brand and creative design experience in SaaS / tech companies

  • Strong portfolio showcasing identity systems and campaigns

  • You keep user experience central to your design thinking, balancing the “why” and “how”

  • Your attention to detail and craftsmanship creates seamless, intuitive design

  • You understand how design decisions interconnect, ensuring cohesive experiences

  • You make informed decisions and stay steps ahead

  • You combine design passion with business acumen and strong relationships

  • Expert in Figma, Paper, Replit, or design tools of choice

  • Experience with digital-first brands and developer tools

  • Understanding of design systems and visual hierarchy

  • Nice to have: Motion design capabilities

Company Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity

  • 20 days paid time off every year

  • 401k

  • $420/month wellness stipend

  • 100% coverage for Health, dental, vision

  • Free Ubers to and from work

  • Free lunch and dinners

  • Annual team offsite (previously went to Alaska, Hawaii)

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer - Pre Sales (SF)

Why Mintlify?

We're on a mission to empower builders.

  • Massive reach: Our docs platform serves 100 million+ developers every year and powers documentation for 20,000+ companies, including Anthropic, Microsoft, PayPal, Spotify, Coinbase, X, and over 20% of the last YC batch.

  • Small team, huge impact: We recently passed 65 employees and raised a $45 million Series B led by A16Z and Salesforce Ventures. Each new hire has a huge impact on shaping the company's trajectory.

  • Culture of slope over y-intercept: We value learning velocity, grit, and unapologetically unique personalities.

We grew in value faster than headcount and we’re looking to align the two quickly.

About the Role

This is a Pre-Sales technical role embedded in Mintlify's Sales Team. You are not a traditional Sales Engineer running canned demos - you are a builder who helps close complex enterprise deals by scoping, prototyping, and delivering custom technical solutions alongside Account Executives.

As enterprise customers evaluate Mintlify, they often require additional technical validation before moving forward. Your role is to reduce friction in this process by translating customer needs into practical technical solutions, building what’s necessary to demonstrate value, and supporting the sales team in closing larger, more complex deals without straining core engineering.

In this role, you will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Product, and the CEO to win our most strategic deals and turn one-off custom work into repeatable, productized capabilities.

This role is for someone who wants to roll up their sleeves and build.


Responsibilities

Deal Execution & Technical Validation

  • Partner with AEs on complex enterprise and mid-market deals from discovery through close

  • Lead deep technical discovery to understand customer documentation workflows, integrations, and success criteria

  • Design and build custom demos, prototypes, and proofs-of-concept that directly unblock deals and accelerate decisions

  • Present technical solutions to mixed audiences, from frontline engineers to executive buyers

Technical Scoping & Risk Management

  • Translate customer requirements into clear technical specifications that engineering can realistically deliver

  • Scope custom work with enough fidelity to inform pricing, timelines, and contract structure

  • Partner with engineering leadership to estimate effort, assess feasibility, and flag risks early. Identify technical debt, integration complexity, or maintenance concerns before deals are signed.

Cross-Functional Enablement & Leverage

  • Serve as the go-to technical operator for Sales on complex deals

  • Share customer and field insights to influence product roadmap and go-to-market strategy

  • Build internal tools, templates, and processes that make technical selling more repeatable and scalable.

Requirements

Technical Skills:

  • Strong full-stack development experience (React, Node.js, APIs, databases)

  • Proficiency in web technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, modern frameworks

  • Ability to rapidly build functional prototypes and MVPs

  • Experience with documentation tools, MDX, or content platforms (strong plus)

  • Comfortable reading and understanding codebases to assess integration complexity

Experience Requirements:

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience in product or customer-facing roles with previous SE, sales engineering, or solutions consulting experience

  • Experience with enterprise RFPs, security reviews, or procurement processes

  • Track record working directly with customers on technical implementations

  • Experience scoping technical work and creating specifications for engineering teams

  • Background in fast-moving startup environments with high autonomy

Behavioral Competencies:

  • You'd rather ship a working prototype than a slide deck

  • You understand how technical decisions impact deal economics

  • You can run multiple complex deals simultaneously without dropping balls

  • You can translate technical depth into business value for executives and explain business constraints to engineers

  • You move fast and ship iteratively

Nice-to-Have

  • Background in developer tools, APIs, or technical products

  • Understanding of SaaS and usage pricing models and contract structures

Company Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity

  • 20 days paid time off every year

  • 401k

  • $420/month wellness stipend

  • 100% coverage for Health, dental, vision

  • Free Ubers to and from work

  • Free lunch and dinners

  • Annual team offsite (previously went to Alaska, Hawaii)

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Mintlify?

We're on a mission to empower builders.

  • Massive reach: Our docs platform serves 100 million+ developers every year and powers documentation for 20,000+ companies, including Anthropic, Microsoft, PayPal, Spotify, Coinbase, X, and over 20% of the last YC batch.

  • Small team, huge impact: We recently passed 65 employees and raised a $45 million Series B led by A16Z and Salesforce Ventures. Each new hire has a huge impact on shaping the company's trajectory.

  • Culture of slope over y-intercept: We value learning velocity, grit, and unapologetically unique personalities.

We grew in value faster than headcount and we’re looking to align the two quickly.

We are looking to hire a generalist who is creative, curious, and content-driven and also wants to soak up all things marketing.

What you'll work on here

  • Building repeatable systems (monthly spotlight series, pre/post-event playbooks) rather than one-off content

  • Creating content for all Mintlify social media platforms (X, LinkedIn, others)

  • Assisting with field marketing and product marketing initiatives as necessary

  • Writing for developers - with a strong understanding of how developers discover and evaluate tools

  • Coming up with creative ways to reach and market to our customers

  • Tracking metrics (pipeline influenced, meetings booked, signups sourced, cost per meeting) and figuring out how to optimize for them

What you bring to the table

  • 2-5 years of experience at an early-stage startup, ideally within the marketing department

  • Strong executional + strategic skills, capable of owning programs end-to-end on a small team with minimal direction

  • Hybrid GTM experience: comfortable spanning PLG (startup/self-serve) and sales-assisted (mid-market/enterprise)

  • Experience working in the dev tools or technical B2B audience space

  • Bonus Points: Experience posting on at least one social media platform in a public capacity - ideally with clear milestones achieved. Familiarity with devtools. Background in community marketing

Why you should join our marketing team

If you’re data-driven and care deeply about building a strong brand, then you have a chance to make an impact here. You will have true ownership over your ideas that translate into events, launches and campaigns you run.

We believe great marketing comes from great teams. The best ideas win here, and we're quick to iterate when something isn't landing. You'll find the sweet spot between the projects that energize you and the goals that move the business forward. You'll test new channels, explore new ideas, and own the results. You'll ship work that people actually see.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

We grew in value faster than headcount and we’re looking to align the two quickly.

About the role

We're hiring a Head of Technical Support to own how Mintlify supports its customers, from fast-growing startups to our largest enterprise accounts. You'll lead a growing team of support engineers and stay hands-on: working the hardest escalations, debugging customer setups, and building the tooling that lets the team scale.

Enterprise comes first. As more large companies run their documentation on Mintlify, they expect clear SLAs, fast escalation paths, and a support partner who can go deep technically. You'll build that motion, raise the operational bar with real metrics, and use AI so support keeps pace as our customer base grows.

  • Team: A growing team of support engineers, with open headcount

  • Location: San Francisco, in office 5 days a week

  • Type: Full-time, player-coach

What you'll do

Build the enterprise support motion

  • Define and run tiered SLAs, priority levels, and escalation paths for enterprise customers

  • Own critical escalations end-to-end, including communication with customer engineering leaders and executives

  • Partner with Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success on onboarding, renewals, and at-risk accounts

  • Handle technical questions in security reviews and complex setups such as SSO, custom domains, and CI/CD integrations

Scale support with AI and automation

  • Deploy and tune AI agents that deflect and resolve common questions, and measure their real resolution rate

  • Build internal tools, scripts, and workflows that cut handle time and repeat work

  • Turn recurring tickets into docs, product fixes, or automations

Tighten the loop with Engineering and Product

  • Own bug triage: clear reproductions, severity, and routing to the right team

  • Bring ticket data into roadmap discussions so the most painful issues get fixed

  • Run incident communication with customers alongside Engineering

Raise the team's operational and technical bar

  • Set up the metrics that matter (first response, time to resolution, CSAT, backlog, escalation rate, AI resolution rate) and report on them weekly

  • Forecast volume and headcount as the customer base grows

  • Hire, coach, and level support engineers; build career paths and a QA process

  • Set coverage and on-call so enterprise SLAs hold

What success looks like

  • 30 days: You've worked tickets and escalations yourself, met the team and key enterprise customers, and have a baseline of current support metrics.

  • 90 days: Enterprise SLAs and escalation paths are defined and live, a weekly metrics review is running, and you've shared a plan for AI deflection and team growth.

  • 6 months: Enterprise SLAs are met consistently, AI resolves a measured and growing share of inbound volume, and bug triage with Engineering runs on a clear cadence.

  • 12 months: Support scales with the customer base, the team has clear levels and career paths, and support data shapes the roadmap.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years in technical support, support engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role, including 1+ years managing a team

  • Experience leading support at a high-growth developer-tools or developer-focused company

  • Strong fluency in docs and developer tooling: Git and GitHub workflows, CI/CD, Markdown/MDX, static sites, APIs and OpenAPI specs, DNS and hosting

  • Hands-on debugging skills: you can reproduce an issue, read logs and config, and explain the root cause to an engineer or a customer

  • You've deployed AI in a support org (agents, deflection, or AI-assisted workflows) and can show what it changed in the numbers

  • Operational rigor: you've defined SLAs, built dashboards, reported metrics to leadership, and forecast volume and headcount

  • Calm, clear communication with enterprise customers during escalations and incidents

  • Able to work from our San Francisco office 5 days a week

Nice to have

  • You've used Mintlify or another docs platform, as a customer or on the team

  • You've built a support function from zero at an early-stage startup

  • You can write code (JavaScript/TypeScript or similar) to build internal tools and scripts

  • Experience with enterprise requirements such as SSO/SAML, security reviews, and custom domains

  • Familiarity with how LLM-based products work (retrieval, prompting, evals), which helps when supporting our AI features

Compensation and benefits

The base salary range for this role is $185,000–$225,000, plus equity. Final pay depends on experience and skills.

Company Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and equity

  • 20 days paid time off every year

  • 401k

  • $420/month wellness stipend

  • 100% coverage for Health, dental, vision

  • Free Ubers to and from work

  • Free lunch and dinners

  • Annual team offsite (previously went to Alaska, Hawaii)
